RolesWorkbench.title: Roles & permissions
RolesWorkbench.description: Every permission here guards a real API route, and a role is the only way to grant one to a person.
RolesWorkbench.tileCatalogueNote: across {resources} resources — derived from the code, not created here
RolesWorkbench.tileConsequentialNote: Delete, approve, publish or protected data
RolesWorkbench.tileRolelessNote: They can sign in and see nothing
RolesWorkbench.noRoleSelected: Pick a role to see what it permits.
RolesWorkbench.holders: {count, plural, =0 {No holders} one {1 holder} other {# holders}}
RolesWorkbench.permissionsGranted: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {1 permission} other {# permissions}}
RolesWorkbench.noDescription: No description recorded for this role.
RolesWorkbench.systemRoleBody: The platform relies on this role to run itself, so its name, its permissions and its existence are all fixed. Create a custom role if you need a different set.
RolesWorkbench.immediateBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role, so nobody is affected.} one {It applies to 1 person on their next request — no sign-in needed.} other {It applies to # people on their next request — no sign-in needed.}}
RolesWorkbench.blockedBody: {count, plural, one {This role holds 1 permission you do not hold yourself} other {This role holds # permissions you do not hold yourself}}, and the API refuses the save while they are in the list. Remove them to save, or ask to be granted them first.

RolesWorkbench.cannotGrant: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it
RolesWorkbench.legendLocked: A disabled box is a permission you do not hold
RolesWorkbench.legendAbsent: An em dash means the permission does not exist for that resource
RolesWorkbench.save_ok: The change applies to everyone holding this role from now.
RolesWorkbench.save_systemRole: This is a system role and cannot be edited.
RolesWorkbench.save_ungrantablePermission: The list includes a permission you do not hold.
RolesWorkbench.save_selfAssignment: You cannot make this change to your own account.
RolesWorkbench.save_forbidden: You do not have permission to edit roles.
RolesWorkbench.save_notFound: This role no longer exists. Reload the page.
RolesWorkbench.save_invalidRequest: The request was rejected. Reload and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_conflict: The data conflicts. Reload and try again.
RolesWorkbench.save_sessionExpired: Your session ended and the permissions were not saved. Reload the page and sign in again.
RolesWorkbench.save_serviceUnavailable: Could not reach the server. Try again.

RolesWorkbench.createHint: The role is created with no permissions. Grant them from the matrix afterwards.
RolesWorkbench.createdBody: It holds no permissions yet. Select it from the list and grant what it needs.
RolesWorkbench.detailsSavedBody: The new name and description apply everywhere this role appears.
RolesWorkbench.archiveBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role, so nobody loses access.} one {1 person holds it and loses everything it grants, immediately.} other {# people hold it and lose everything it grants, immediately.}} The role is removed from every account holding it, and this screen cannot undo it.
RolesWorkbench.archivedBody: It is no longer listed and no longer grants anything.
RolesWorkbench.save_impliedReadMissing: Not saved: the role grants a change to a resource without permission to read it. The screen ticks the read automatically — check what was unticked by hand.

RolesWorkbench.incoherentBody: These resources are ticked for change but not for read, and the save will be refused: {resources}
RolesWorkbench.catalogueNote: Every permission here guards a real API route, and the list is derived from the source itself. Permissions are not created here: a new row would create one that guards nothing.
RolesWorkbench.catalogueCaption: Every permission on the platform, and who holds it.

Editorial.readinessReady: Nothing is standing in the way of publishing.
Editorial.readinessBlocked: Publishing is held until these are settled:

Editorial.blockedDefinitionMissing: The policy requires approvals but names no usable review path. An administrator must correct it.
Editorial.blockedDefinitionInactive: The review path the policy names is inactive. An administrator must activate it or name another.
Editorial.blockedDefinitionForeignType: The review path the policy names governs a different kind of content. An administrator must correct it.
Editorial.blockedUnknown: Publishing is not configured for this kind of content.

Editorial.noActions: You have no action available on this record right now.

Editorial.reasonHintReturn: Say what must change before it is resubmitted.
Editorial.failureTitle: The action did not go through
Editorial.staleTitle: This record changed after you opened it

Newsroom.title: News & Articles
Newsroom.description: Write, submit for review and publish news.
Newsroom.hintTags: Free words for display and filtering, up to {max}. Press Enter after each one. Not the category.
Newsroom.errorTagLength: That tag is longer than allowed.
Newsroom.errorTagDuplicate: That tag is already on this article.
Newsroom.errorRange: That range ends before it starts.
Newsroom.slugHint: Lowercase letters and digits joined by hyphens.
Newsroom.reviewDescription: What is waiting on you specifically.
Newsroom.policiesDescription: Turn review on for any content type, and say who decides.
Newsroom.policySummaryNobody: Requires approval and names nobody — nothing of this type can be published.
Newsroom.policyLocked: One review is running under this arrangement — who approves cannot change now.
Newsroom.policyLockedPlural: {count} reviews are running under this arrangement — who approves cannot change now.
Newsroom.policyLockedWhy: Changing who approves retires the step those reviews are waiting at, leaving them undecidable. Finish or cancel them first.
Newsroom.policyLockedStillAllowed: You can still switch approval off for this type, or re-save the same arrangement unchanged.
Newsroom.policySaveRefused: Not saved. A review started since this page was opened. Reload to see the current count.
Newsroom.errorThreshold: That is more than the number of approvers.
Newsroom.editorDescription: Write the article in Arabic and English, then save it as a draft or send it for review.
Newsroom.createDescription: Fill in the required fields to create the article. Review and publishing come after it exists.
Newsroom.hintAuthor: The name readers see. May differ from the account that wrote the article.
Newsroom.hintCategory: “Federation in the media” is for articles the federation wrote about its own coverage. External media coverage is a separate record.
Newsroom.hintSlug: Lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens, e.g. national-championship-2026. One address for both languages.
Newsroom.errorTitle: The headline is required in Arabic and English.
Newsroom.errorAuthor: The byline is required in Arabic and English.
Newsroom.errorSlugInvalid: Lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens only.
Newsroom.errorSlugTaken: Another article already uses this address.
Newsroom.errorSlugRaced: Not created: another editor claimed this address moments ago. Change it and try again.
Newsroom.bodyEmptyBoth: The article text has not been written in either language yet.
Newsroom.bodyEmpty_ar: The Arabic text has not been written yet.
Newsroom.bodyEmpty_en: The English text has not been written yet.
Newsroom.policyOrderHint: Each approver reviews after the one before them. Use the arrows to reorder.
Newsroom.policyDeadlocked: This type requires approval and names nobody, so nothing of it can be published. Name at least one approver, or turn approval off.
Newsroom.policyListHint: Choose a policy to see and change its settings.
Newsroom.statInReviewNote: Approvers cannot change until they finish
Newsroom.statAttentionNote: Require approval with no valid approver
Newsroom.rowMetaInTurn: {total, plural, one {# level in turn} other {# levels in turn}}
Newsroom.policyAllExplained: Nothing is published until all {total} of {total} approve — every approver named above, in any order.
Newsroom.policyOffExplained: No review applies to this type — every change is published when saved. Turn on “Requires approval” to name approvers.
Newsroom.groupApplyHint: Separate from saving: copies the saved arrangement of “{name}” — whether approval is required, the mode, the approvers and the count — to the other policies in “{group}” at once, without touching other groups.
Newsroom.groupApplyNeedsSave: Save or discard the changes to “{name}” first — applying copies what is saved.
Newsroom.groupApplyAlone: There are no other policies in this group.
Newsroom.groupApplyNothing: Every policy in the group is already the same or has reviews running — nothing to apply.
Newsroom.groupApplyDiscardsDrafts: Unsaved changes will be replaced on: {names}
Newsroom.groupApplyResults: Result of applying to the group
Newsroom.groupApplyResult_refused: {name}: refused, a review started since this page opened

Messages.title: Messages
Messages.description: What arrives through the contact page's “Send us a message” form, newest first.
Messages.accessDenied: You do not have permission to read the messages.
Messages.chooseMessage: Choose a message from the list to read it.
Messages.readOnly: Read only: changing the status needs permission to update messages.
Messages.toastFailed: Could not change the message's status
Messages.toastFailedDetail: Its status is unchanged. Try again.
